title: "Personal Visualization Journey"

Add content here

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
step_count <- read_csv("pvj_data.csv")


step_count <- step_count |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"),
       steps = as.numeric(steps)) |> 
  mutate(day_of_week = wday(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) |> 
  select(date, day_of_week, steps)
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = steps)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

```{r}
ggplot(step_count, aes(x = day_of_week, y = steps)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
